data.one_liner: Renders Flutter text, link, and image widgets as HTML elements for SEO purposes on the web.
data.what_it_does: Detects web crawlers using user-agent regex and automatically adds corresponding HTML elements (like headings, paragraphs, links, and images) to the DOM for better search engine optimization.
use_when: You are building a Flutter web application that requires search engine indexing.
You need to render text, links, or images as native HTML elements for web crawlers.
avoid_when: Your application is exclusively for mobile or desktop platforms without web targets.
You do not care about search engine indexing for your Flutter web app.
strengths: Automatically detects web crawlers via regex and user agent.
Supports rendering text, rich text, links, and images as HTML elements.
Integrates smoothly with navigator observers and MaterialApp.
weaknesses: Under development, which may mean potential API changes or edge cases.
Requires manual configuration in index.html for reliable web renderer behavior in some scenarios.
data.setup_notes: Wrap MaterialApp in a RobotDetector widget and add seoRouteObserver to navigatorObservers.
